'''2007 Pennsylvania State Championship Mike Gemme LS You Can Either Profit By This...''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mike Gemme]] at [[2007 Pennsylvania State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|EJP-L-youcaneitherprofitbythis.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Michael Gemme
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
